title: Frosted privacy film on a glass partition: before and after | VAM Deco
description: A clear glass partition transformed with frosted film: privacy at eye level while keeping the natural light. See the before and after of a real project in Ticino.
h1: Frosted privacy film: from clear glass partition to private space
estratto: Before, you could see straight through the glass. After, with the frosted film applied by VAM Deco, the glass partition provides privacy without giving up the light. Drag the slider and see the difference.

primaDopo.didascalia: Drag the slider: on the left the original clear glass, on the right the frosted film applied by VAM Deco.

sezioni.heading: The problem: too much transparency
paragrafi: A fully glazed partition brings light and lightness to a space, but it has a downside: it offers no privacy at all. In this project, inside a modern exposed-concrete building, the glass wall separated the entrance from the stairwell, leaving everything behind it (and in front of it) on full view.

The owner wanted to keep the natural light coming from above, while screening the area at eye level so as not to feel exposed to passers-by. Replacing the glass with a frosted one would have been expensive and invasive.

sezioni.heading: The solution: frosted film with a sandblasted-glass effect
paragrafi: Frosted (satin) film is an opaque adhesive film that is applied directly onto the existing glass and transforms its look: the glass turns milky like factory-frosted glass, letting the light through but not the view.

We applied the film only to the section at eye level, leaving the upper panels clear: this way the space stays bright, but the passage area is private. The installation was carried out to a high standard, with no bubbles or halos, precisely following the divisions of the black frame.
lista: A uniform, elegant and discreet frosted-glass effect.
It costs a fraction of replacing the glass and is far quicker.
It is applied on glass that is already installed, without removing anything.
It is reversible: the film can be removed in the future without damaging the glass.

sezioni.heading: The result: privacy and light together
paragrafi: The result is exactly what was needed: privacy at eye level and natural light from above. The wall now protects the space without weighing it down, and the satin effect blends perfectly with the exposed concrete and the black profiles of the architecture.

It is a clean, fast and made-to-measure job, produced in-house here in Ticino. The same solution works for offices, meeting rooms, bathrooms, shop windows, professional practices and homes: anywhere you need discretion without giving up brightness.

faq.risposta: It is an opaque adhesive film applied to the glass that reproduces the effect of frosted glass: it makes the glass non-transparent while still letting the light through. It is the ideal solution for privacy without darkening the room.

faq.domanda: Does frosted film still let the light through?
faq.risposta: Yes. Unlike a curtain or a dark panel, frosted film blocks the view but lets natural light filter through, keeping the room bright and airy.

faq.domanda: Can it be applied to glass that is already installed?
faq.risposta: Yes, it is applied directly onto the existing glass, without removing windows, doors or glass walls. Installation is quick and requires no building work.

faq.domanda: How long does frosted film last?
faq.risposta: With professional materials and correct installation it lasts for many years while keeping its uniform effect. You clean it normally like glass, avoiding abrasive products.
Yes, it is reversible: if in the future you want to go back to clear glass or change solution, the film can be removed without damaging the glass.
